name: sandbox-vanity-statue
description: Vanity projects (#1947): at grade 3 the Build menu's Vanity section is locked and `build ceo_statue` is refused with cash untouched. At grade 4 (`sandbox start ... grade:4`) the player builds the CEO Statue from the Vanity section: exactly $250,000 is charged and average crew morale dips once (mandatory saluting).

steps.command: sandbox start biome:desert_badlands kit:full seed:42 staffed:true grade:3

interaction.command: sandbox start biome:desert_badlands kit:full seed:42 staffed:true grade:3

steps.description: Progression site opened at grade 3 (Quarry Licence), one short of the board's statue.
Grade 3: the Vanity section is listed but locked; the statue cannot be bought and the console refuses it too.

expect.note: #1947 -- below grade 4 the Vanity section is locked with its grade.

steps.command: sandbox start biome:desert_badlands kit:full seed:42 staffed:true grade:4

interaction.command: sandbox start biome:desert_badlands kit:full seed:42 staffed:true grade:4

steps.description: Same site at grade 4 (Regional Licence): the board would like a statue.
Grade 4: build the CEO Statue from the Vanity section. It costs exactly $250,000 and the crew's average morale dips (mandatory saluting).
Observe: the statue stands; the dip is a one-off, not a recurring drain (average morale is read once more after the build).
